Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers (India) Limited held its Q4 and FY2026 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management reported strong revenue and profit growth for the quarter and full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing. The company aims to scale manufacturing utilization to 100% by the end of FY2027 and expand its product portfolio into non-textile industries and wood coatings. Furthermore, management noted that internal cash flows and resources will support future working capital needs and minor machinery additions without major debt expansion. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year of FY26, highlighting strong growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax.

guidance.claim: Management expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year '27.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA can increase by 200 to 300 basis points upon full capacity utilization.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve full capacity utilization of the new manufacturing plant by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue from manufacturing and trading to be equal within 1 and 2 years.
guidance.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

guidance.claim: At full utilization, total turnover from manufacturing with the 500-ton capacity is expected to be around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted improving demand trends in the wood coating segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance, prompt technical services, and regulatory preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing as Bangladesh faces various challenges.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Kochi office was added during the quarter for domestic wood coating products.
capex_expansion.quote: And in this quarter, we added the Kochi office for domestic wood coating products.

capex_expansion.claim: The current facility allows for product flexibility and capacity expansion without further incremental capex.
capex_expansion.quote: So we need not require for more capex. And the same can be, facility can be utilized for manufacturing in coming times if it is inks and wood coating polymers, we will be okay with that same facility.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: Proactive inventory strategy has helped secure raw materials at favorable blended costs to provide near-term margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin stood at 33.2% for Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (%) 33.2% 39.0% -580 bps 25.0% 820 bps 28.2% 25.8% 240 bps

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin reached 23.1% in Q4 FY26.
In Q3 FY26, EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2% in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax rose by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with the PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax also showed strong growth, rising by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.

margins_costs.claim: Currently, the manufacturing margin is around 25% and is expected to reach near about 50% according to production.
margins_costs.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

margins_costs.claim: Reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12% following the start of manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%. And in the coming time, as more products come in, that reliance will keep decreasing.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of the new manufacturing facility is 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first two months after starting manufacturing, capacity utilization was around 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital will not become a constraint due to internal availability and good cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are very confident working capital will not become a constraint at least in the near future.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the manufacturing capex, INR30 crores is a loan from the bank, INR10 crores was funded through IPO to purchase land, and the rest from internal accruals and unsecured loans from promoters.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: Additional working capital requirements will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: It of course internal accruals. As huge capex is not required. So there is no need to go for the huge capex.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that Bangladesh has been facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production costs, and stricter compliance requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of the revenue mix in FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, the vision is to establish Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our vision is to establish Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company among the most advanced and sustainable players in India's textile and coating solution space.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year '27.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: New machinery will be added over the next couple of months to expand the product portfolio and enter adjacent categories.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

management_commitments.claim: The company will intimate details regarding non-textile binder trials within a couple of months once finalized.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in industry exhibitions and technical seminars.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions (GMMSA, Knit Show) and technical seminars.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to selectively expand market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic wood coating segment.
management_commitments.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve full plant capacity utilization by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: Trading and manufacturing revenues are expected to be equal within 1 and 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.
